detail.longDescription: How is it already 0:55?! I sat down this evening to just write a quick # tutorial for deploying an enter-three-witches # game to a small # webserver and securing it with # nginx and # certbot , and now it’s four hours later. But the tutorial is done: https://www. draketo.de/software/enter-thre e-witches#webservice My most recent game that uses this setup is the interactive fiction game Terra’s Heritage: https:// dryads-wake.1w6.org/terras-her itage I’d love to hear how it works for you! # guile # scheme # wisp # webdev # programming # lisp # gamedev # writing
